Elaine CS: Quick sync: Peregrine go-live is Wed 05/15. Need final quota number, autoscale knobs, and a simple CS priming script. Can we align?
Sam SRE: I can run the load. Need traffic mix + token estimates. Also recommend a 10% canary for first 30m.
Marcus SE: Traffic mix: 65% short-chat (~40 tokens), 25% long-complete (~200 tokens), 10% embeddings. Expected steady 140 qps, peak 700 qps for 3x10m bursts. Reserved pool requested: 8 GPUs.
Deepak Runtime: For peak 700qps, recommend per-GPU batch=8, continuous batching, and KV cache priming. Autoscale: min=4 max=14, scale-up policy latency-based, cooldown-up=60s cooldown-down=180s. Quant profile: q4_0.
Elaine CS: Renewal risk: customer will evaluate SLA if p95 > 350ms week 1. Mark that for AMs.
Sam SRE: Test plan: smoke (15m @20%), soak (90m @70%), burst (3x10m @700qps), chaos (remove 1 GPU mid-soak). Will prepare scripts and dashboards.
Marcus SE: I'll drop traffic-profile and sample prompts into gs://redwood-peregrine/test-artifacts and share ACL with anna@peregrine. Also confirm KMS rotation blackout during soak.
Deepak Runtime: Minimal priming command for CS (set $TOKEN):
```
./loadgen --profile peregrine_chat.json --qps 140 --duration 900 --auth $TOKEN
```
ops-bot: scheduled job created: "peregrine-go-live-dryrun" - 2024-05-14T16:00:00Z Owner: Sam SRE
Elaine CS: Can we hold billing/quota change until soak pass and signoff? Finance prefers hold for 7 days post-pass.
Sam SRE: Agreed. Sam -> run dry-run tomorrow 18:00 PT, post grafana links + artifacts.
Deepak Runtime: I'll prepare fallback route to gpt-medium-quant with auto-switch if p95>480ms or error-rate>0.5% for 5m.
Elaine CS: Great. Reconvene Mon EOD for final sign-off. Action items: Sam scripts, Marcus traffic+KMS, Deepak autoscale+fallback, Elaine billing hold.
All: ack :thumbsup:
